cluster.headline: Sagar hooch tragedy death toll reaches 25 in Madhya Pradesh
cluster.summary: Twenty-five people have died after consuming toxic liquor in the Banda area of Sagar district, with dozens hospitalised and many patients referred to AIIMS. A shopkeeper denied selling spurious liquor, saying the price was only Rs 20 lower.

sources.title: सागर जहरीली शराब कांड: 20 रुपये कम था दाम, दुकानदार बोला- नकली शराब नहीं है

cluster.reason: Nothing close to this in the CMS.
cluster.pickReason: 25 dead from toxic liquor, accountability angle on excise failure; fresher and higher toll than duplicate
